fields.value: A spending limit that holds across separate launches under one experiment label

Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: "Yeah okay, this probably is its own task".

## Why

An agent tending training may change what it launches, but only inside a limit. Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on what such an agent may do without asking: "11c almost certainly. but probably there are firm boundaries like the cant exceed the experiment budget."

Today a job has `max_usd` and `max_hours` enforced across its attempts, and a cohort launched together shares a `max_usd`. Nothing limits the total of several launches made at different times under the same experiment: a continuation, a retry by hand, an extra seed and an evaluation each bring their own cap.

## Scope note

Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: "this is, I think, a formal definition of an experiment that sits with Etude Cloud. I think an Etude SDK experiment is just kind of a nice name for a label". So this Task must not turn the SDK's experiment into a formal record. The question it answers is the smallest thing that makes a limit hold across launches that share a label.

## Outcome

A design, then delivery, for a limit keyed by experiment label: where the limit and the running total live (the launcher database on one computer does not cover two people or two computers; the bucket might), what counts toward it (training, evaluation, idle rented time, transfer), what a launch that would exceed it does, and how a person raises it. Say plainly which part needs the hosted product and leave that part out.

## Context

Cohort and job limits: `docs/launcher.md`. EXP-58 owns machine costs and their attribution to runs; this owns the limit. Positioning notes: `scratch/positioning.md` in the Manabot worktree `manabot.aa55a0-move-run-execution` (MTG-329).
